correctness.rationale: The exact cap integration yields the normalized cubic. Two interlacing signs force three simple negative roots for 0<q<q*. At q=q* the fixed root and positive-discriminant negative quadratic identify the unique double-root height. For every delta>0 an exact discriminant expansion with two strictly negative verified coefficients and negative cubic coefficient gives a nonreal pair at common u*. Rational pi bounds and trigonometric series verify all signs and the polygon threshold; an included executable checks the algebra.

value.rationale: The invariant is the real-rootedness of the ordinary Euclidean outer-parallel-volume polynomial; the theorem gives a natural complete and sharp criterion over every compact convex planar base, regardless of smoothness, for every positive prism height. The universal witness height and the regular six-to-seven side transition reveal structural geometry not determined by the known circular-cylinder example or a generic product formula.
